desc: Establish the MST minimax-path property and threshold-component characterization.
Prove that the increase in the sum of componentwise `min(A_count, B_count)` at each merge equals the number of newly feasible pairs, which should be charged at that merge weight.
Implement the DSU solution with duplicate occurrences handled as counts, successful unions only, 64-bit-safe arithmetic, and efficient sorting.
Validate the implementation on both samples and repeated-occurrence/final-merge edge cases.
